paragraphs.text: Kalitas ( /kɑːlitɑːs/, KAHL-ee-tahss ) was the bloodchief of the Ghet, the poorest and least powerful of the vampire families of Malakir on Zendikar .

The Ghet seized holdings outside of Malakir, including the port city of Nimana, and threatened to turn all of the vampires of Malakir into thralls of the Eldrazi . Though Drana prevented his scheme for the other families, she couldn't prevent Kalitas from submitting his own family to mindless servitude beneath the Eldrazi.
As Drana is proclaimed to be the last bloodchief after the defeat of the Eldrazi, Kalitas is presumably dead.
